PEN_YARD.//: The Beast Pen's later upgrades (note 06: 'Training dummy and sparring ring (later upgrades): spar two of your own pets ... No faints, little XP'; built after Part 14). Moves have no xp of their own in the game (they come with battle level), so sparring gives a little battle xp: `spar.hours` of the Pen's training rate to each, once every `spar.every` hours a pet, never past the Pen's training cap. The dummy makes idle training `dummy.trainPct` quicker.
